dateEvidence.excerpt: IH7423-400 official launch entry opens 2026-10-01T14:00:00.000Z.

products.description:
The wait is nearly over. Change the game in the Caitlin 1. Her step-back creates space on demand. Her first step sets the pace. A responsive Air Zoom Turbo unit paired with Cushlon foam helps you stay smooth and controlled through every move. The innovative Nike Opticast upper delivers lightweight, locked-in support, so you can push tempo without feeling weighed down. Finished with signature details special to Caitlin, this shoe is made for hoopers who shoot without hesitation and make logo splashes the new normal.

Look closely for the 22’s and CC’s molded into the upper. Her signature pops on the heel and her logo on the midfoot reflects her range from anywhere.

Caitlin’s game goes wherever you step. Both shoes read “It was never a long shot,” with “Shoot more threes” on the left and “From anywhere” on the right.

products.description:
Demerits are points against a student's record for breaking the rules.

"I was almost expelled from high school for wearing my soccer shoes to class instead of the all-black dress shoes that were required by school policy", Tom Sachs remembers. That’s when I figured out I could just color in the white swoosh with a marker to avoid demerits."

Test limits by breaking the rules. Accept the penalties but never forget them. Artists are champions who push up to the edge of what can be achieved through work. Wear your demerits with pride so you can live without regret.
